description: Rich espresso balanced with velvety steamed milk and a touch of sweetened condensed milk.
Freshly steamed milk with vanilla syrup, marked with espresso and topped with caramel drizzle.
Bold double-shot espresso topped with a thick, chilled layer of lightly sweetened whipped cream.
Smooth, full-bodied espresso blended with creamy steamed milk and a light layer of foam.
Creamy, caramelized crustless cheesecake with a rich, velvety center.
Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with whipped mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.
Fudgy dark chocolate brownie drizzled with house-made salted caramel and flaky sea salt.
Crispy, buttery croissant waffle topped with whipped cream and a dusting of powdered sugar.
